mn23:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn23:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Kumārakassapo Andhavane viharati.
mn23:1.4: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Andhavanaṃ obhāsetvā yen' āyasmā Kumārakassapo ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā āyasmantaṃ Kumārakassapaṃ etad-avoca:
mn23:2.1: Bhikkhu bhikkhu, ayaṃ vammīko rattiṃ dhūmāyati divā pajjalati.
mn23:2.4: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa laṅgiṃ:
mn23:2.9: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa uddhumāyikaṃ:
mn23:2.14: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa dvidhāpathaṃ:
mn23:2.19: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa caṅgavāraṃ:
mn23:2.24: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa kummaṃ:
mn23:2.29: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa asisūnaṃ:
mn23:2.34: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa maṃsapesiṃ:
mn23:2.39: Abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa nāgaṃ:
mn23:2.42: Tiṭṭhatu nāgo, mā nāgaṃ ghaṭṭesi, namo karohi nāgassāti.
mn23:2.43: Ime kho tvaṃ bhikkhu pañhe Bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyāsi, yathā te Bhagavā byākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāsi.
mn23:2.44: Nāhan-taṃ bhikkhu passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya aññatra Tathāgatena vā Tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā ti.
mn23:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Kumārakassapo tassā rattiyā accayena yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Kumārakassapo Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn23:3.2: Imaṃ bhante rattiṃ aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Andhavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhante sā devatā maṃ etad-avoca:
mn23:3.3: Bhikkhu bhikkhu, ayaṃ vammīko rattiṃ dhūmāyati divā pajjalati.
mn23:3.10: Ko nu kho bhante vammīko, kā rattiṃ dhūmāyanā, kā divā pajjalanā, ko brāhmaṇo, ko sumedho, kiṃ satthaṃ, kiṃ abhikkhaṇaṃ, kā laṅgī, kā uddhumāyikā, ko dvidhāpatho, kiṃ caṅgavāraṃ, ko kummo, kā asisūnā, kā maṃsapesi, ko nāgo ti.
mn23:4.1: Vammīko ti kho bhikkhu imass' etaṃ cātummahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsūpacayassa aniccucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsanadhammassa.
mn23:4.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhu divā kammante ārabbha rattiṃ anuvitakketi anuvicarati
mn23:4.4: Yaṃ kho bhikkhu rattiṃ anuvitakketvā anuvicāretvā divā kammante payojeti kāyena vācāya manasā
mn23:4.6: Brāhmaṇo ti kho bhikkhu Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
mn23:4.7: Sumedho ti kho bhikkhu sekhass' etaṃ bhikkhuno adhivacanaṃ.
mn23:4.8: Satthan-ti kho bhikkhu ariyāy' etaṃ paññāya adhivacanaṃ.
mn23:4.9: Abhikkhaṇan-ti kho bhikkhu viriyārambhass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn23:4.10: Laṅgī ti kho bhikkhu avijjāy' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
mn23:4.12: abhikkhaṇa sumedha satthaṃ ādāyāti ayam-etassa attho.
mn23:4.13: Uddhumāyikā ti kho bikkhu kodhupāyāsass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
mn23:4.15: abhikkhaṇa sumedha satthaṃ ādāyāti ayametassa attho.
mn23:4.16: Dvidhāpatho ti kho bhikkhu vicikicchāy' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
mn23:4.18: abhikkhaṇa sumedha satthaṃ ādāyāti ayam-etassa attho.
mn23:4.19: Caṅgavāran-ti kho bhikkhu pañcann' etaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ:
mn23:4.22: abhikkhaṇa sumedha satthaṃ ādāyāti ayam-etassa attho.
mn23:4.23: Kummo ti kho bhikkhu pañcann' etaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
mn23:4.26: abhikkhaṇa sumedha satthaṃ ādāyāti ayam-etassa attho.
mn23:4.27: Asisūnā ti kho bhikkhu pañcann' etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ:
mn23:4.28: cakkhuviññeyyānaṃ rūpānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ,
mn23:4.32: kāyaviññeyyānaṃ phoṭṭhabbānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ; \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn23:4.34: abhikkhaṇa sumedha satthaṃ ādāyāti ayam-etassa attho.
mn23:4.35: Maṃsapesīti kho bhikkhu nandirāgass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
mn23:4.37: abhikkhaṇa sumedha satthaṃ ādāyāti ayam-etassa attho.
mn23:4.38: Nāgo ti kho bhikkhu khīṇāsavass' etaṃ bhikkhuno adhivacanaṃ;
mn23:4.39: tiṭṭhatu nāgo, mā nāgaṃ ghaṭṭesi, namo karohi nāgassāti ayam-etassa attho ti.
mn23:4.41: Attamano āyasmā Kumārakassapo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 24.
